scenes.label: Need fancy kit?
scenes.vo: Think you need fancy kit to film your nets?
All you need is your phone, a tripod and a net.
Put the tripod behind the stumps at the bowler's end.
One times zoom for bowling, three times for batting.

scenes.label: Head still ✓
scenes.vo: Then watch it back in slow-mo.
And it all stays on your phone.
Follow Crease Cam for the launch.
